pricingModel.value: Per connected account per month, cheaper per account at volume

freeOption.value: First 2 accounts free, no credit card

trial.value: No trial needed: the first 2 connected accounts are free with the full API, no credit card

plans.value: No named plans or seats (“no plans, no seats”): accounts 1–2 free, 3–10 $6/month each, 11–100 $3/month each, 101+ $1/month each, every feature on every account

networks.value: Social, messaging, blog and ads platforms through one API, including X, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, Threads, Reddit, Pinterest and Bluesky

api.value: The product is the API: posting, analytics, comments, messaging, ads and webhooks

teams.value: No seat fees; owner and invited members share one team. SAML and OIDC SSO on self-serve; SCIM, audit logs and role-based access on Enterprise
